{{Quote|I should have been with my clan when the Empire came for them. I had left to join another clan, to follow a lover. At the moment they were betrayed, I knew nothing.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:ZL">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Zadik Lone}}</ref>}}
'''Clan Spar''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan that operated by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Rook presented Major Stanwu with evidence that Clan Spar reneged on a contract. My people were hired to destroy transport ships full of young Jedi, but the Empire's target survived. If Clan Spar had accepted that contract, the Jedi would be dead. Rook framed us.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:IV">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Imperial Vendetta}}</ref>}}
During the Great Galactic War, Clan Spar served as allies of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and participated in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] where they were amongst over a hundred battle hardened [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] that participated in the battle at [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. In the battle, this venerable clan suffered numerous casualties at the hands of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]]. This led to the clan swearing an oath to repay the debt for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] suffered at the hands of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, the clan members were framed for crimes against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire before they could make good on their promise,<ref name="TOR:MKJ" /> by the false Mandalorian [[Tayari Rook]].<ref name="TOR:TToTR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|The Trail of Tayari Rook}}</ref> Rook claimed that Clan Spar had gone back on a contract to destroy [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]], when no such contract had been made. Unfortunately for Clan Spar, Rook managed to convince [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stanwu]], an Imperial liaison officer between the Empire and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Stanwu then transmitted the false information to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] who signed the execution order.<ref name="TOR:IV" /> The Imperial [[22nd Regiment]]<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> debilitated the clan with [[Poison gas/Legends|poison gas]], capturing and later [[Death/Legends|executing]] the members of Clan Spar.<ref name="TOR:ZL" />

The only known survivor was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Mandalorian by the name of [[Akaavi Spar]], who had been away from the clan with a [[Zadik Lone|lover]] during the attack. When she learned of the Empire's betrayal, Akaavi called upon her lover's clan for aid, but [[Clan Lone]] would not rally to support Clan Spar.<ref name="TOR:ZL" /> Akaavi Spar set out to find the architect of her clan's demise,<ref name="TOR:IV" /> joining forces with an up-and-coming [[Voidhound|smuggler]], eventually uncovering Tayari Rook's actions and tracking his whereabouts to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. There, she killed Rook and any member of his criminal [[Clan Rook/Legends|clan]] of false Mandalorians that did not flee during the course of her assault, taking revenge for Clan Spar's downfall.<ref name="TOR:CR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Clan Rook}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Spar was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:IV" />
